title: Below This Current, Nothing Happens
summary: A neuron charges like a leaky capacitor until it trips a threshold, fires, and resets. Drag the input current down and at one exact value the output stops entirely.

sources.title: Lapicque's 1907 paper: from frogs to integrate-and-fire (Brunel & van Rossum, 2007)
Gerstner et al., Neuronal Dynamics, ch. 1.3: integrate-and-fire models
Dayan & Abbott, Theoretical Neuroscience, ch. 5: model neurons
